rationale: The Court is most likely to adopt a McNeill-inflected, backward-looking rule anchoring the CSA schedules to the time of the prior state drug offense/conviction to avoid ACCA predicate status fluctuating with later rescheduling or charging timing. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (dynamic-incorporation/fair-notice framing) and from Justice Gorsuch or Justice Thomas to emphasize textualism and separation-of-powers concerns about a moving federal schedule.
